title: The neutral lipidome in Parkinson’s disease
title_zh: 帕金森病中的中性脂质组
abstract: Abstract Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disease with increasing evidence implicating lipid and fatty acid metabolism as important contributors to pathogenesis. Disrupted lipid metabolism, including sphingolipids, ceramides, cardiolipins, cholesterol, phospholipids and others, have been implicated in PD pathological processes, such as alpha-Synuclein (αS) aggregation, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation. PD-associated dysregulation of neutral lipid metabolism is emerging as a key contributor to PD-associated lipid dyshomeostasis, prompting investigation of novel PD therapeutic targets and biomarkers in this pathway. However, PD-associated alterations of the human ‘neutral lipidome’ remains poorly understood, motivating this review. Herein, we comprehensively evaluate human studies reporting PD risk loci and concentrations of neutral lipids (triacylglycerols [TAGs], diacylglycerols [DAGs], monoacylglycerols [MAGs]) in samples from individuals with or without PD. Genetic and lipidomic evidence supports a dysregulated neutral lipidome in PD, as indicated by: (i) PD risk loci in or affecting neutral lipid metabolism pathways, (ii) PD-associated differences in neutral lipid concentrations in postmortem brain tissue and biofluids, (iii) meta-analysis-identified association between higher TAG concentrations and lower PD risk, (iv) PD candidate therapeutic targets in neutral lipid pathways, and (v) candidate neutral lipid PD biomarkers. Collectively, these data support the disruption of neutral lipid homeostasis as a contributing mechanism in PD. Thus, we propose the PD-associated neutral lipidome as an underexplored and important axis contributing to PD pathogenesis that can be targeted for the development of PD biomarkers and disease-modifying therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 摘要 帕金森病（PD）是一种神经退行性疾病，越来越多的证据表明，脂质和脂肪酸代谢在病理发生中起着重要作用。包括鞘脂、陈旧脂、心肌脂、胆固醇、磷脂在内的受损脂质代谢已被证实与PD的病理过程有关，如α-突触核蛋白（αS）聚集、氧化应激和神经炎症。PD中中性脂质代谢的失调正成为PD脂质代谢异常的关键贡献因素，促使人们研究该通路的新型PD治疗靶点和生物标志物。然而，PD相关人类‘中性脂质组’的改变仍知之甚少，因此撰写本综述。综上，我们全面评估了报道PD风险位点和中性脂质（三酰甘油[TAGs]、二酰甘油[DAGs]、单酰甘油[MAGs]) 浓度的研究，这些研究涉及PD患者或无PD个体的样本。遗传和脂质组学证据支持PD中中性脂质组的失调，表现为：(i) PD风险位点位于或影响中性脂质代谢通路，(ii) PD患者尸检脑组和体液中中性脂质浓度的差异，(iii) 通过元分析识别出的较高TAG浓度与较低PD风险之间的关联，(iv) PD候选治疗靶点位于中性脂质通路中，以及(v) PD候选中性脂质生物标志物。综合这些数据，支持中性脂质稳态的破坏是PD的贡献机制。因此，我们建议PD相关中性脂质组作为PD病理机制中被低估且重要的轴，可作为PD生物标志物和疾病修饰治疗靶点的开发目标。
